practical: Torque tightening practice on simulated fasteners using calibrated torque wrenches; Safety precautions include PPE usage and zeroing tools; Instructor supervision ensures correct technique and reading interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of torque tightening in aircraft maintenance?
Name two types of torque giving tools used in aviation.
Why is it critical to follow correct aircraft maintenance practices regarding fasteners?

topics: Selection and Calibration of Torque Wrenches
Principles of Correct Aircraft Maintenance Practices
development.content:
Introduction to Torque Giving Tools
Selection and Calibration of Torque Wrenches
Principles of Correct Aircraft Maintenance Practices

Torque Calculation Formulas
Conversion of Units and Factors
Interpretation of Torque Specifications

Hands-on Torque Tightening Practice
Verification of Applied Torque Values
Common Errors and Correction Techniques

summary_questions: Explain the relationship between torque, force, and lever arm length.
Describe the procedure for verifying that a fastener has been tightened to the correct specification.
Identify three common errors that can occur during torque tightening and their consequences.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the torque calculation method discussed and outline the key steps for the next lesson plan (LP 02) regarding specific aircraft fastener applications.
